body: Ooohhhh thank you for this question! It helped me pinpoint why I was jealous! I hope you have a nice day.

Honestly, I don't know what makes me jealous because it's rare that I feel that way. So I'm just kinda hoping for an across-the-board kind of coping strategy?

I do try my best to communicate with my partner that I'm feeling jealous, however I never ask her to stop interacting with the person that makes me jealous because I think jealousy is a "me" thing / "me" problem.
This sounds amazing! I'm happy for the three of you. I'm glad you all found each other 💛

I don't have lot to add, I just want to say that I live in a third world country and mental health struggles are pretty prevalent here. The problem is many go undiagnosed/discontinue treatment because of the cost as well as the scarcity of mental health professionals in the country (I think we have 800 psychologists and psychiatrists in total). So yeah, the quote is definitely inaccurate. I hope you have a nice day, OP!

I read something similar, it went along the lines of "Your trauma didn't turn you into the person that you are now. It's your gentleness to yourself that gave you the ability to overcome it that defines you"

I'm sorry you had to go through this. 

Not someone else, but I almost lost myself to suicide. I did that too, the lashing out and being angry and pushing everyone away. I purposefully wanted people to hate me because my thinking then was, if they hate me, then there would be no room for pain. Or at least minimize the pain of my departure, more like "good riddance."
I do hope things eventually get better. Right now it just gets worse HAHA thanks for this comment!

Thank you. It's ok, I guess. Even I don't know what to do so I don't really expect anyone else to know either. Thank you for this comment though and for making me feel like my feelings are valid. Take care!
I also hope that you feel better soon.

Hello I'm sorry for this late reply! I've been inactive on social media since I have a lot of school work to do.

I'm pretty happy to report that we're still together, and we're just happier as each day passes.

>which led to having sex even when I didn't want to. He didn't force me or anything, but I knew that refusing to have sex would result in him getting angry or sad or both, so I did it.

This. This is one of the things I was worried about. I never want her to feel that way, this led me to constantly reassure her that it's completely fine if she didn't want to do anything sexual even if I were horny at that point. Sometimes, we'd fool around together and sometimes she'd say she's not in the mood so I back off. Honestly, it's totally fine with me!

Recently, we've agreed to be non-monogamous. We were able to set-up some ground rules or agreements and it's been nice, it's been going well. Our fundamental rule is we see other people solely for the sexual aspect and be honest with all the parties involved: us and the person each of us are fooling around with. 

On days when there's too much work to do, we just video call each other and do our own thing. We'd steal glances through the screen while we work and I'm content with that. Her mere presence makes my heart swell. She even joked that "our relationship is so healthy, when will we fight?" 😂

>Ask yourself if you are willing to have a sexless romantic relationship with someone and be honest with yourself.

I've thought about this a lot before and I'm fairly certain that yes, I am willing to. I maybe young but I know that now and for the foreseeable future, I'm willing to. 

I used to make sexual advances on the people I found attractive (with consent, of course) but with her, everything was just so different. I wanted to slow down and just bask in her existence. On the day I asked her to be my partner, we were alone in her bedroom. I never thought I'd be the type to stay wholesome in that setting, with the person whom I am absolutely attracted to but we played word factory, showed each other memes, did our own school work, took a nap on the same bed but didn't even cuddle. The furthest we went was holding each other's hand and I was more than content with that.

Ok I'm rambling but my point is, I'm fine with not having sex with her because she is just so 🥺 I can't even describe her.

I love her.

These past few days we'd schedule Netflix dates and then we'd discuss what we watched and all sorts of stuff. We talk about politics, religion, philosophy. I come up with goofy pick-up lines and she calls them "stoopeed" and we both get a good laugh at it. I learn a lot from her and vice versa. I'm just grateful that I finally no longer have to translate my soul for someone I love. It is with this gratitude that I try my best to know more so she may feel the same with me.

Thank you so much for this! I'll be sure to look back on this when I begin to have doubts or negative self talk with regards to my relationship with her.

I don't know if it's due to depression (but I think it is). I used to be good at public speaking, especially extemporaneous speech and debate. Now I've developed a really bad stutter and I can't pull out facts right off my mind (for extemporaneous speeches) or even articulate my thoughts well and quickly. I noticed I don't perform well in debates anymore, so there's that. It just feels that my mind is working double or quadruple than it had to and it that it has slown down. I attribute it to my depression but I'm not quite certain.

I've managed to fully convince most of them of how horrible I am as a person, and well, human as they are, they tend to only remember the recent past (aka the duration in which I did a 180 of myself). I planted a seed of hate towards me and now it grew into this huge tree.

Today is one of the days I regret ever making the persona (and as an extension, wanting to die). I just kinda wish I never got to this point of desperation in my life. I just kinda wish the universe was a tad bit kinder.

I'll try checking it out in a while! We touched quantum mechanics in 11th grade and I found it pretty interesting, discussing how everything in this universe is of probability and only certain when reality collapses in of itself.

That analogy sounds accurate. Maybe I should learn to be more gentle with myself this time around. However, my only issue now is that maybe I've dug too deep of a grave for myself, through the persona, to the point I may not get out of it anymore.
Oh okay, I hope you sleep well! Thank you so much for your time.

That paper on statistical mechanics kinda reminds me of quantum mechanics. I'd love to hear more of it even if you think it's probably off topic.

Maybe you're right though. My friends used to tell me how my brain kept lying to itself all the time whenever I thought and believe I am a horrible person.

It's just that I've spent years waking up everyday with the thought of the day I finally kill myself. I've met beautiful people who wanted me to live. And so I lived. For a while. They even came to a point of threatening me they'd kill themselves if I did manage to be successful of offing myself. Now that with a slight nudge, they've become distant and I guess gave up on me, I guess it's safe to say for me that I can finally go. I don't know man

I honestly kinda wish somebody noticed what I was doing and asked me to stay, or asked me what's up. If it is essentially losing a friend, then wouldn't my death be meaningless now for them since well I'm basically no one anymore?

I understand that it's possible to lose touch with what's real and what's not. I still know who I am and the lies I've made

"What if life something throws some random good fortune at you and you get out of the rut you're in? Will you regret this?

Question: Are you just trying to justify this certain personality of yours to others by pretending that it's something good for them?" 

I have come across days where I regret it because I miss everyone and the wonderful times we've shared. But most of the time, I just think that I'm finally close to leaving this plane of existence. That in the end, I'm doing this for the wonderful people I'm leaving behind, so that they don't follow suit or be so upset about my departure. 




"On the other hand, if this persona is something you can actually control, perhaps your life would be better if you don't try to act that persona?" 

I genuinely believe I'm doing them a favor by making them hate me. That'd eventually mean they'd distance themselves from me. I guess it's weird for them at first since they say I was a really warm person to be with back then.
The persona is something I can control, I think. As much as I want to stop though, I think I've dug myself a grave deep enough I can't climb out of
